description: This Java class implements a command strategy for retrieving policy entries within a persistence context, specifically handling the RetrievePolicyEntries command and generating corresponding results or error responses.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyEntriesStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy to handle retrieval of policy entries in response to RetrievePolicyEntries commands.

methods.name: RetrievePolicyEntriesStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with the RetrievePolicyEntries class type.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the logic to retrieve policy entries, returning a Result containing either the policy event or an error if the policy is not found.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Computes the next EntityTag based on the updated policy entity, if present.
